message:
Fix private-cache segment reuse across root params (#98810)

Private caches only tracked root-param reads in development. Production
runtime prefetches omitted these dependencies from their vary params
metadata, allowing the client to reuse content across different
root-param values.

This extends #98674 to `"use cache: private"`. Private caches now
collect root-param reads in production and inherit dependencies from
nested public and private caches. The existing response-level
propagation can then record those dependencies when it consumes the
cache entry.

Regression tests cover direct reads, public caches inside private
caches, and private caches inside private caches. Each case prefetches
English and German content, then verifies that navigation uses the
German result without another request.
